key.name: enabled
key.summary: Dictate while the Copilot key is held
key.description: When on, holding the Copilot key listens and types what is said into the focused text field. Turning it on in Settings downloads the speech model first.

key.name: language
key.description: A language code such as "en" or "sr". Empty follows the keyboard layout being typed with, then the language the computer is set to.

key.name: engine
key.description: Automatic uses Parakeet for the 25 European languages it knows and Whisper, on the graphics card, for the others.
